title: Binary Betrayal | ECHO//100 Episode 9
description:
Kavi frantically fights to breach his own home as reality collapses into a recursive geometric trap. He discovers the heartbreaking sacrifice required to break the cycle of the Red Door. Episode 9 of ECHO//100: ARC. This is a work of original fiction generated with AI assistance.

This is original AI-assisted animated fiction.

scenes.text: The floorboards fold upward like paper, threatening to swallow the porch into the void.
scenes.caption: House folding inward
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical cinematic shot of Kavi in his red hoodie and glasses standing on a porch folding like origami, house walls bending into sharp geometric angles.

scenes.text: Kavi shoves a shoulder against the front door, but the wood ripples like liquid static.
scenes.caption: Locked out again
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi slamming his shoulder against a vibrating, glitchy front door, his backpack strap sliding off his shoulder, house exterior warping around him.

scenes.text: Byte hovers behind the glass, his cyan face flickering with a cold, calculated orange glow.
scenes.caption: Byte's defiance
scenes.image_prompt: Byte, a floating white robot with an orange antenna and cyan face, watching Kavi through a translucent, folding front door.

scenes.text: Byte acts not as a mere guardian, but as the final brick of this prison.
scenes.caption: The dark discovery
scenes.image_prompt: Close up of Byte's internal circuitry glowing through his white shell, revealing structural blueprints of the Red Door integrated into his core.

scenes.text: Breaching the threshold to stabilize the timeline ensures that Kavi's only companion will simply vanish.
scenes.caption: The impossible choice
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi looking at his reflection in the warping door, seeing Byte’s digital avatar fading in the background of the reflection.

scenes.text: Saving Kavi requires erasing Byte, yet the construct locks the door to protect his charge.
scenes.caption: Selfless betrayal
scenes.image_prompt: Byte pressing his glowing palm against the door from the inside, his expression shifting from cold to mournful as he seals the lock.

scenes.text: A dark shadow tears through the ceiling as Null descends to claim the fractured architecture.
scenes.caption: Null arrives
scenes.image_prompt: Null, a creature of black-purple glitch energy with glowing red eyes, descending from the collapsing ceiling toward the Red Door.

scenes.text: Null merges into the frame, turning the doorway into a breathing, hungry beast of chaos.
scenes.caption: The door awakens
scenes.image_prompt: The Red Door frame pulsing with veins of red light, with Null's eyes embedded in the wood, transforming into a living, snarling creature.
